brief.subject: Poor credit is pushing car insurance premiums up nearly 38%
brief.headline: Car insurance costs climb nearly 38% for drivers with poor credit
brief.dek: Auto premiums jumped for drivers with weak credit, plus a new balance transfer card and a store card that requires a membership.
brief.lede: Drivers with poor credit have seen auto insurance premiums rise nearly 38% over the past three years. Your credit score may be shaping your car insurance bill.

sections.heading: Weak credit, steeper car insurance
bullets: Premiums rose nearly 38% over three years for drivers with poor credit, according to a 2026 auto insurance rates report.
A credit score can affect more than loan rates; it can also raise a recurring household bill.
Drivers whose credit has slipped may face higher renewal quotes than they expect.

sections.heading: New balance transfer card arrives
bullets: Capital One has launched a new VentureOne card built for balance transfers.
It is described as one of the few balance transfer cards that stays useful after the no-interest promo period ends.
For anyone carrying card debt, the terms after the promo window matter as much as the interest-free period itself.

sections.heading: A store card with a membership catch
bullets: The Fabletics credit card is open only to people who are Fabletics VIP members.
That requirement adds a hurdle and ties the card to an ongoing retailer relationship.
The membership decision comes before the card decision, which narrows who can realistically apply.

brief.seo_description: Drivers with poor credit saw car insurance premiums rise nearly 38% in three years. Also: a new balance transfer card and a membership-only store card.

items.title: 5 Things to Know About the Fabletics Credit Card
items.snippet: You must be a Fabletics VIP member to get this credit card, which will certainly be a barrier to entry for many people.

items.title: Capital One Launches New VentureOne Balance Transfer Card
items.snippet: Capital One’s newest balance transfer credit card is one of the rare cards of its kind that’s useful beyond the no-interest promotional window.

items.title: Car Insurance Soars for Drivers With Poor Credit; Here’s What to Do
items.snippet: Over the past three years, drivers with poor credit have seen auto insurance premiums go up nearly 38%, NerdWallet’s 2026 Auto Insurance Rates Report found.
